{{Quote|What were they? Couple of Jedi gone rogue or something?|Morlimur questioning the Jedi about the Nightbrothers|<ref name="Revival (episode)">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Morlimur Snugg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] who worked for the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as a [[Superintendent/Legends|superintendent]]. He owned the [[ALC-9]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], he guided around [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] after the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] [[Raid on the Cybloc Transfer Station/Legends|raided]] the [[Cybloc Transfer Station/Legends|Cybloc Transfer Station]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Morlimur Snugg was voiced by [[Jim Cummings]], who also portrays [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] in the series.
